title: Diagnose and fix deployment error preventing successful build

requirements.text: Investigate and identify the specific build or deployment error that is preventing Draft Version 20 from deploying successfully
acceptanceCriteria: Build logs are reviewed to identify the exact error message and stack trace
The root cause of the deployment failure is identified (backend compilation error, frontend build error, or deployment configuration issue)
Error is documented with specific file paths and line numbers if applicable

requirements.text: Fix any Motoko compilation errors in backend/main.mo that are preventing successful backend build
acceptanceCriteria: All Motoko syntax errors are resolved
Type mismatches and undefined variables are fixed
Backend compiles successfully without errors
All existing backend methods remain functional

requirements.text: Fix any TypeScript or React compilation errors in frontend source files that are preventing successful frontend build
acceptanceCriteria: All TypeScript type errors are resolved
Import statements and module paths are correct
React component syntax errors are fixed
Frontend builds successfully without errors
All existing components render without runtime errors

requirements.text: Verify that all React Query hooks in useQueries.ts have correct actor method calls and proper error handling
acceptanceCriteria: All mutation and query hooks correctly reference existing backend methods
No undefined method calls or incorrect parameter passing
Error boundaries handle failed queries gracefully
Query invalidation patterns are correct

requirements.text: Ensure all component imports and routing configuration in App.tsx and main.tsx are correctly structured without circular dependencies
acceptanceCriteria: No circular import dependencies exist
All page components are imported correctly
Router configuration has valid paths and elements
AuthProvider and QueryClientProvider are properly configured

requirements.text: Run the complete build and deployment process end-to-end to verify all errors are resolved and the application deploys successfully
acceptanceCriteria: Backend canister deploys successfully
Frontend builds and deploys without errors
Application is accessible at the deployment URL
All existing features remain functional after deployment
No console errors appear on initial page load

constraints: Do not modify the single-actor backend architecture
Preserve all existing features and functionality during error fixes
Do not edit read-only frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useInternetIdentity.tsx, useActor.ts, main.tsx, and components/ui directory
nonGoals: Adding new features beyond error fixes
Refactoring working code that is not causing errors
Changing the UI design or styling
